propositions: Operators lack an on-demand, non-blocking diagnostic to verify that mapped Jira project keys and legacy_default in projects.json are visible to the bot outside a full reconcile pass.

The new --live-visibility flag on rebar bridge fsck must perform a READ-ONLY, credential-conditional visibility check using the shared helper check_mapped_project_visibility without mutating bridge state or altering the command's exit contract.

When JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN credentials are absent or incomplete and no probe is injected, the fsck step must emit an advisory skipped verdict with reason="missing_credentials" without calling the probe and without failing.
The visibility advisory must be rendered to stderr in both text and JSON output modes and must NOT alter the existing stdout JSON schema or add new required fields to the findings object.
Core rebar doctor must remain Jira-free with no reconciler or [agents] optional-extra import reachable from _commands/doctor.py.
